## Headroom Learned Patterns
*Auto-generated by `headroom learn` on 2026-07-21 — do not edit manually*

### Backend Architecture
*~38,000 tokens/session saved*
- Backend was refactored from a single `backend/server.js` (route handlers) into `backend/modules/<domain>/<domain>.service.js` + `<domain>.routes.js` (bounded contexts: auth, wgs, tasks, shopping, finances, calendar, messages, push). `server.js` now only mounts routers — check `backend/modules/` before assuming logic lives in `server.js` or the old `backend/routes/*.js`.
- Large hot files that get re-read across tasks: `backend/server.js`, `frontend/src/components/{DashboardClient,MainLayout,ShoppingClient,TabsNav,ProfileModal}.tsx`, `frontend/src/index.css`. Read each once in full at task start rather than re-reading after every unrelated edit.

### Dev Server / Environment
*~4,500 tokens/session saved*
- Port 3000 is frequently already occupied by a leftover `node server.js` process, causing `EADDRINUSE` on every fresh start attempt. Run `lsof -ti:3000 | xargs kill -9` (or check `lsof -i :3000 -sTCP:LISTEN`) before starting the backend, and prefer `nohup node server.js > /tmp/log 2>&1 &` with a log file over inline background subshells so startup errors are visible without retries.
- Backend fails fast (`process.exit(1)`) if `JWT_SECRET`, VAPID keys, or `RESEND_API_KEY` are missing from `backend/.env` — check `.env` exists and has all required keys before attempting to start the server.
- macOS `timeout` command is not available in this shell; use `(cmd & PID=$!; sleep N; kill $PID)` instead.

### Testing
*~3,000 tokens/session saved*
- `npx cypress run` fails first-run Gatekeeper verification of the cached `Cypress.app` binary on this Mac; `npx cypress install --force` and clearing `~/Library/Caches/Cypress` alone did not resolve it in past sessions. Try `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine` on the cached binary, or fall back to `npx vitest run` for coverage instead of retrying `cypress run` repeatedly.

### Environment / Sandbox Shell Quirks
*~2,500 tokens/session saved*
- The sandboxed `find` wrapper rejects compound predicates/actions (`-not`, `-exec`, mixed `-o` with depth flags) with `rtk: find does not support compound predicates or actions` — use a single simple predicate per `find` call, or split into multiple calls.
- Shell cwd persists between Bash tool calls in this environment; running `cd backend && ...` when already inside `backend/` fails with `no such file or directory: backend`. Check with a single `pwd` or use absolute paths instead of chaining redundant `cd`.

### Secrets
*~1,500 tokens/session saved*
- `backend/.env` was previously committed to git history (leaked JWT/Resend/VAPID keys), requiring `git filter-repo --path backend/.env --invert-paths` + force-push to purge. Always verify `backend/.env` is in `.gitignore` and never `git add` it; if new secrets are ever generated, rotate rather than reuse revoked ones.
